title: Campaigns
subtitle: Your Google Ads campaign plan, worked out from your store's products and sales.
load_error: We could not load the campaign plan.
no_store_title: Connect your store to get a campaign plan
no_store_desc: The plan starts from your store's catalog and sales.
save_error: We could not save. Please try again.
ready_title: The plan is ready to launch
blocker_ads_account: Choose the Google Ads account to use
blocker_currency: Choose a Google Ads account in your store's currency ({{store}}), not {{account}}
blocker_no_offers: No product can enter the campaign right now
existing_ads: Your store already runs Google ads: {{orders}} ({{total}}) in the last 90 days. At launch, Hontrio checks which campaigns run in the account, so the new one does not compete with them for the same products.
campaign_hint: What Hontrio will create in your Google Ads account. You pay Google directly for the ads.
type_pmax: Performance Max, from your Merchant Center catalog
type_pmax_hint: One campaign for the whole eligible catalog, using only the products in your feed. Google builds the ads from your products, shows them on Shopping, Search and its other channels, and learns on its own where they sell. With few sales, one campaign learns faster than several small ones.
empty_included: No product enters the campaign right now.
footer: The plan is worked out from the synced catalog and the website orders of the last 90 days. Products left out stay unchanged in Merchant Center. Hontrio only keeps them out of the campaign.
blocker_merchant_woocommerce: Send your products to Merchant Center (Google for WooCommerce)
blocker_conversion_edinio: Set up the purchase conversion in Edinio
blocker_conversion_woocommerce: Measure purchases in Google Ads (Google for WooCommerce)
conversion_ok: Purchase, the one already set up via {{via}} (no new one is created)
conversion_ok_unknown: Purchase, the one already set up (no new one is created)
verified_at_launch: Hontrio can't check the plugin from here, so we check it at launch, from the Google account.
blocker_merchant_shopify: Send your products to Merchant Center (Google & YouTube app)
blocker_conversion_shopify: Measure purchases in Google Ads (Google & YouTube app)
verified_at_launch_shopify: Shopify doesn't tell apps which sales channels a store has, such as Google & YouTube, so we check at launch, from the Google account.
blocker_merchant: Send your products to Merchant Center
action_decided: This proposal has already been decided.
action_expired: This proposal has expired because more than 7 days have passed and the figures behind it have changed. If it still applies, the autopilot will propose it again on its next pass.
budget_over_max: The new budget would go over the maximum you set for all campaigns ({{max}} a day), so it wasn't applied. Raise the maximum budget in the Autopilot tab if you want it to grow.
graduate_too_many: This campaign can't move to Performance Max because its product list would have {{items}} entries, and Google accepts at most {{limit}} per group. It stays on Standard Shopping.
pilot_error_title: The autopilot couldn't run on its last pass
pilot_error_hint: Until this is fixed, the safety stop and the proposals are on hold. The autopilot retries on its own.
pilot_error_token: Google didn't grant access to the account this time ({{code}}).
action_not_found: We couldn't find the proposal or campaign.
audit_hint: Before changing anything, Hontrio checks the running campaigns, the purchase conversion, the Merchant Center link and the EU political advertising declaration in your account. The audit changes nothing.
audit_all_ok: The account is ready for launch.
audit_history: Account conversions in the last 30 days: {{conversions}} · active campaigns: {{campaigns}}.
audit_failed: We couldn't check the account. Try again.
audit_no_account: First choose the store's Google Ads account in Settings.
audit_too_soon: You just checked. Wait a minute.
overlap_question: The account already has Shopping or Performance Max campaigns on the same products ({{count}}). What should we do with them?
overlap_pause_hint: Recommended. Otherwise your campaigns and Hontrio's bid against each other on the same products and push the cost per click up. They aren't deleted, and you can resume them anytime.
overlap_keep_hint: The Hontrio campaign gets the lowest Shopping priority so yours come first. With Performance Max, the campaign with the higher Ad Rank wins anyway.
eu_confirm: I confirm that none of the existing campaigns without a declaration ({{count}}) contains EU political advertising. Google requires the declaration for every campaign. Without it, since April 1, 2026, it refuses any change in the account, including the launch.
launch_done: The campaign was created in your Google Ads account and starts within a few hours, after Google's review.
stage_starter_hint: Conversions in the account in the last 30 days: {{conversions}}, below the 15 Google needs to bid on value by itself. We start with a Standard Shopping campaign, with “Maximize clicks” and a safety stop. Once there are enough sales, the autopilot proposes moving to Performance Max.
stage_growth_hint: Conversions in the account in the last 30 days: {{conversions}}, enough for Google to bid on value by itself. The campaign is Performance Max with only your feed products, and Google aims for the highest sales value it can get from the budget.
type_shopping: Standard Shopping, from the Merchant Center catalog
type_shopping_hint: Product ads only, in Search and the Shopping tab. Google bids by itself to bring as many clicks as the budget allows, and the search terms stay visible. That way we learn cheaply until there are enough sales for Performance Max.
bidding_cpc_low: The cap is very low, so the campaign will get little traffic. With larger orders, the cap goes up.
safety_value: The autopilot stops the campaign at {{none}} spent without a single sale, or at {{low}} with sales below the cost of the ads
safety_hint: The loss limit also works in approval mode, as a safeguard. If it pauses the campaign, you get a notification and can restart it.
safety_unknown: Worked out from the average order, once there are products that can run
settings_presence: Only people located in the country, not those merely “interested” in it
settings_eu: Declared as containing no EU political advertising (a Google requirement)
settings_utm: Hontrio UTMs on the link, so sales also show up in your store
settings_no_partners: No search partner network, at first
settings_no_expansion: The click always lands on the product page (no URL expansion)
settings_feed_only: Feed products only, which Google uses to build the ads
settings_brand: Searches for your store's name stay with your Search campaign: {{terms}}
exclusions_value_one: {{count}} product left out of the campaign
exclusions_value_other: {{count}} products left out of the campaign
exclusions_hint: We leave them out of the campaign only, by their Merchant Center ID. Your feed stays untouched, so they don't disappear from your own campaigns.
exclusions_unmatched_one: {{count}} product to exclude isn't found in Merchant Center yet, so it can't be left out of the campaign. The next sync fixes it.
exclusions_unmatched_other: {{count}} products to exclude aren't found in Merchant Center yet, so they can't be left out of the campaign. The next sync fixes it.
exclusions_label: For more than 990 exclusions, Hontrio puts its own label in Merchant Center, in a separate data source, and the campaign uses it.
ended_graduated: Moved to Performance Max on {{date}}. Its figures stay in Reports.
ended_on: Ended on {{date}}. Its figures stay in Reports.
paused_loss_limit: Paused by the autopilot at the loss limit. The reason is in the log, and once you've fixed it, you can resume it.
live_footer: The numbers come from Google Ads, one day late. Google reports sales value including VAT.
mode_approve_desc: The autopilot proposes, you approve. On its own it only runs the safety stop, keeps the campaigns' product lists up to date and stops scheduled campaigns on their end date.
mode_auto_desc: The autopilot applies changes by itself, within the limits below, and logs them. The budget only goes up with your approval. You get a notification.
max_budget_hint: All Hontrio campaigns' budgets together can go up to this amount. The autopilot only proposes increases, and the budget never goes up without your approval.
proposals_empty: No proposals right now. The autopilot checks the figures every day.
detail_graduate: Performance Max with a {{budget}}/day budget, and the starter campaign stops
reason_loss_no_conversions: It hit the loss limit without a single sale. First check that purchases are being measured and that prices are competitive, then resume the campaign.
reason_graduate: Account conversions in 30 days: {{conversions}}, enough for Google to bid on value by itself. The campaign moves to Performance Max.
reason_budget_limited: The campaign runs out of budget every day and sells {{actual}} times what it spends. With more budget it can bring more sales. The decision is yours.
reason_exclude_products_one: A product spent money in the last 30 days without sales, or more than it sold, so we take it out of the campaigns. You can include it again from the plan.
reason_exclude_products_other: {{count}} products spent money in the last 30 days without sales, or more than they sold, so we take them out of the campaigns. You can include them again from the plan.
reason_negatives_one: One search term spent money without any sale, so we add it as an exact negative.
reason_negatives_other: {{count}} search terms spent money without any sale, so we add them as exact negatives.
reason_sync_products_one: The plan changed, and the campaign now excludes one product.
reason_sync_products_other: The plan changed, and the campaign now excludes {{count}} products.
blocker_audit: Check the Google Ads account (the audit below)
blocker_account_manager: Choose the store's advertiser account, not a manager account
blocker_merchant_not_linked: Link Merchant Center to the Google Ads account
blocker_merchant_other: The store's Merchant Center ({{merchant}}) isn't linked to this Google Ads account
blocker_merchant_choose: In Settings, choose the store's Merchant Center out of the {{count}} linked to the account
blocker_purchase_missing: Create the purchase conversion in Google Ads
blocker_purchase_not_primary: Make the purchase conversion primary so Google bids on it
blocker_purchase_no_value: Send the order value with the purchase conversion
blocker_too_many_exclusions: Choose the Merchant Center account so Hontrio can exclude the {{count}} products with its own label
check_account_manager: The chosen account is a manager account, and campaigns only run in advertiser accounts.
check_currency_mismatch: The account currency ({{account}}) differs from the store's ({{store}}).
check_auto_tagging_off: Auto-tagging (gclid) is off, so Google can't connect clicks to orders. Turn it on in the Google Ads account settings.
check_merchant_not_linked: No Merchant Center is linked to this Google Ads account. Link it from Google Ads (Tools → Linked accounts) or from Merchant Center.
check_merchant_other: The store's Merchant Center ({{merchant}}) isn't linked to this account, and Shopping campaigns need the link.
check_merchant_choose: The account has {{count}} linked Merchant Center accounts. Choose the store's one in Settings.
check_purchase_missing: There's no active purchase conversion. Without it, Google doesn't know which clicks become sales.
check_purchase_not_primary: The purchase conversion exists but isn't “primary”, so Google doesn't use it for bidding.
check_purchase_no_value: The purchase conversion always uses the same value instead of the order value. The autopilot couldn't tell what sales bring in, and the safety stop would judge wrongly.
check_no_recent_conversions: No conversions in the last 30 days. Check that the tag fires on the order confirmation page.
check_eu_undeclared: Campaigns without the EU political advertising declaration: {{count}}. Google refuses any change in the account until they're declared, and you can declare them at launch.
check_overlap: Shopping or Performance Max campaigns on the same products: {{count}}. Choose below what we do with them.
check_search_active: The account has a Search campaign. Searches for your store's name stay with it, through a negative keyword added to the Hontrio campaign.
ended_scheduled: Its period ended on {{date}} and the products went back to the main campaign. Its figures stay in Reports.
board_main_rest: All products that aren't in one of your campaigns
board_new_desc: By category, brand, price range, products on sale or products you pick. Each campaign has its own budget, and the autopilot manages it every day.
blocker_no_offers_groups: All products that can run are in your group campaigns.
g_block_empty: Choose the campaign's products by category, brand, price range, discounts or your own pick.
g_block_no_products: None of the campaign's products can run right now (sold out, rejected by Google or excluded from campaigns).
g_block_not_in_merchant: The campaign's products aren't found in Merchant Center yet, so Google Ads can't select them. This is fixed at the next sync.
g_block_too_many_items: Performance Max can select at most {{limit}} products by ID, and this campaign has {{count}}. Choose Standard Shopping or split it in two.
g_block_period: The period isn't valid because the end date is in the past or before the start.
g_warn_few_products_one: The campaign has only one product, so Google has little to show and the campaign learns slowly.
g_warn_few_products_other: The campaign has only {{count}} products, so Google has little to show and the campaign learns slowly.
g_warn_excluded_members_one: One product in the group can't run right now because it's sold out or was taken out by you or the autopilot. It joins the campaign by itself once that's fixed.
g_warn_excluded_members_other: {{count}} products in the group can't run right now because they're sold out or were taken out by you or the autopilot. They join the campaign by themselves once that's fixed.
g_warn_unmatched_one: One product isn't found in Merchant Center yet and stays out of the campaign until the next sync.
g_warn_unmatched_other: {{count}} products aren't found in Merchant Center yet and stay out of the campaign until the next sync.
g_warn_in_other_group_one: One product matched by the rules is already in another of your campaigns and stays there.
g_warn_in_other_group_other: {{count}} products matched by the rules are already in another of your campaigns and stay there.
g_warn_pmax_low_data: Conversions in 30 days: {{conversions}}, below the 15 Google needs to bid on value by itself. Performance Max learns slowly like this, and Standard Shopping would learn more cheaply.
g_warn_main_low_data: Conversions left for the main campaign: about {{remaining}} a month, below the 15 that value-based bidding needs. A small group often sells better if it stays in the main campaign.
g_warn_over_max_budget: All Hontrio campaigns would spend {{total}} a day, above the maximum budget you chose ({{max}}). The autopilot won't raise budgets above it by itself.
g_warn_low_budget: The budget is under half of the suggested one ({{suggested}}), so the campaign will get little traffic and learn slowly.
g_warn_short_period: Days in the period: {{days}}. Performance Max needs about 6 weeks to learn, so Standard Shopping fits a short promotion better.
g_subtitle: Pick the products, then how it runs. Hontrio suggests the budget and the campaign type from their sales.
g_launched: “{{name}}” was created in your Google Ads account and starts after Google's review. The main campaign no longer sells its products.
g_start_hint: Choose one or more criteria. A product only qualifies if it meets all of them. Then tick or untick products in the list.
g_categories_hint: The categories in your store. New products in them join the campaign on their own.
g_brands_hint: The brands in your catalog. Their new products join the campaign on their own.
g_sale_hint_one: Products discounted from their old price. There's one right now.
g_sale_hint_other: Products discounted from their old price. There are {{count}} right now.
g_manual_hint: Tick the products in the list below. Picked by you so far: {{count}}.
g_basis_store: orders from Google, in your store
g_list_empty: No products yet. Choose a criterion above or tick products from the whole catalog.
g_remove_product: Remove the product from the campaign
g_add_product: Add the product to the campaign
g_name_hint: It comes from the chosen products, and you can change it.
g_budget_hint: Suggested: {{budget}} a day, a fifth of the average order with the group's products ({{aov}}). Leave it empty to use the suggested budget.
g_type_locked: The type can't change after launch, because Google would create a new campaign.
g_type_auto_shopping: Conversions in 30 days: {{conversions}}. It starts as Standard Shopping (“Maximize clicks”) and moves to Performance Max by itself once it reaches 15.
g_type_auto_pmax: Conversions in 30 days: {{conversions}}, enough for Google to bid on value by itself. The chosen type is Performance Max.
g_type_shopping_desc: Product ads only, a cap per click, visible search terms. Good for products with few sales and for short promotions.
g_type_performance_max_desc: Google shows the products on every channel and bids on value by itself. It needs ~15 conversions a month and a few weeks of learning.
g_period_hint: Useful for a promotion. Google starts and stops the campaign on its own on the chosen dates, and at the end the products go back to the main campaign.
g_live_note: Changes to the products, the budget and the end of the period reach Google Ads right away.
g_launch_note: This campaign's products ({{products}}) leave the main campaign, so the two don't compete for the same products.
g_launch_note_alone: This campaign's products: {{products}}. All other products that can run are already in your campaigns.
reason_sync_group_one: The campaign's rules now match one product.
reason_sync_group_other: The campaign's rules now match {{count}} products.
reason_end_scheduled: The chosen period ended, so the campaign stopped and its products went back to the main campaign.
reason_graduate_group: The campaign's conversions in 30 days: {{conversions}}, enough for Google to bid on value by itself. The campaign moves to Performance Max.
group_limit: You can have at most {{max}} group campaigns at the same time. End or delete one to create another.
group_name_invalid: The campaign name must be 1 to 80 characters.
group_period_invalid: The end date must be after the start date.
group_period_past: The end date is in the past.
group_type_locked: The campaign type can't change after launch.
group_start_locked: A launched campaign's start can't change.
group_delete_live: End the campaign first, then you can delete it.
g_choose_first: Choose above what to do with your existing campaigns
page_description: Your Google Ads campaigns, managed daily by the Hontrio autopilot. Here you see what they bring in, what the autopilot proposes and the plan behind each one.
load_error_hint: Check your connection and try again.
meta_pilot_off: The autopilot starts at the first launch
filter_empty_desc: Pick another filter or create a new campaign.
sheet_products_group: Products matching the rules below. New ones join on their own.
sheet_google_none: No campaign in Google Ads yet. At launch, Hontrio creates it in your account.
kpi_value_help: The value of orders Google Ads reports for Hontrio campaigns, including VAT.
kpi_roas_help: Sales value divided by spend. Below 1, the ads cost more than the sales they brought in.
kpi_spend_help: What you paid Google for Hontrio campaigns. You pay Google directly, not through Hontrio.
overview_proposals_hint: Approve or reject them in the Autopilot tab
overview_proposals_none: The autopilot checks the figures every day
overview_campaigns_hint: Figures for the last 30 days. Open a campaign for details.
pilot_idle_title: The autopilot starts after the first launch
pilot_idle: From the day after launch it reads the Google Ads figures and proposes (or makes) the changes. Choose now how you want it to work.
proposals_hint: The autopilot proposes, you decide. Without approval it only runs the safety stop, keeps product lists up to date and ends scheduled campaigns.
proposals_hint_auto: In automatic mode, the autopilot applies routine changes by itself. Only those that need you stay here.
journal_hint: Everything that changed in the Google Ads account, by the autopilot or by you.
pilot_rules_hint: In either mode, so it doesn't break what works:
pilot_rule_budget: Doesn't raise the budget without your approval. It proposes a 20% increase, at most once a week.
pilot_rule_learning: Doesn't change a new Performance Max campaign's budget during its first 6 learning weeks.
pilot_rule_loss: Stops a campaign by itself when it has spent an average order without a single sale, or more than its sales brought in.
launch_card_starter: A Standard Shopping campaign launches, with “Maximize clicks” and a safety stop. Products: {{products}} · budget: {{budget}} per day.
launch_card_growth: A Performance Max campaign launches with only your feed products, no target ROAS and a safety stop. Products: {{products}} · budget: {{budget}} per day.
launch_wait_choices: Choose below what to do with your existing campaigns
products_hint: What enters the campaign, what's in your group campaigns and what stays out, with the reason.
g_summary_blockers_one: One issue to fix before launch
g_summary_warnings_one: One thing to know, at the launch step
g_summary_warnings_other: {{count}} things to know, at the launch step
trend_empty_title: The first figures are on their way
trend_empty: Google reports spend and sales a day late. The chart fills in from the day after launch.
bidding_clicks: Maximize clicks, at most {{cpc}} per click
bidding_clicks_hint: Google bids by itself, within the budget. The cap is 1% of the average order ({{aov}}), so at one sale per 100 clicks, the sale pays for its ad.
bidding_value: Maximize conversion value, without a target ROAS
bidding_value_hint: Google bids by itself to bring the highest sales value it can from the budget.
budget_hint_history: The suggestion starts from what you spend per day on Shopping and Performance Max today ({{budget}}). Leave the field empty to use the suggested budget.
budget_hint_aov: Suggested: {{budget}} a day, a fifth of the average order ({{aov}}), to start small. Leave it empty to use the suggested budget.
budget_hint_none: Enter how much you want to spend per day.
kpi_conversions_help: The orders Google Ads reports for the Hontrio campaigns.
pilot_rule_products: Takes out products that spent their price without a sale, or cost more than they sold. You can include them again.
reason_loss_below_cost: It spent {{spend}} on ads, and the sales it brought in ({{value}}) are below that cost, so the campaign was surely losing money. Check the prices and products, then you can restart it.
col_ads_hint: What Google Ads reported for the product in the last 30 days, across all Shopping and Performance Max campaigns.
verified_at_launch_platform: {{platform}} doesn’t tell apps whether it sends products to Google or measures purchases, so we check at launch, from the Google account.
